name: Dante's Inferno - The Game
source:
Based off the classic, Dante's Inferno by Dante Alighieri, a group of four classmates created a visual novel in a modern setting for the story to provide easier understanding of the book. It is for-fun adventure we did for class, but since we put so much work into it, we decided to post it to the public too!

[From [url=https://games.renpy.org/game/dantes-inferno---the-game]Ren'Py Games List[/url]]
translation:
改编自但丁·阿利吉耶里 (Dante Alighieri) 的经典作品《但丁的地狱》，四位同学在现代背景下创作了一部视觉小说，让故事更容易理解。这是我们在课堂上进行的有趣冒险，但由于我们投入了大量精力，我们决定也将其发布给公众！

[来自[url=https://games.renpy.org/game/dantes-inferno---the-game]Ren'Py游戏列表[/url]]
